column1: # GitHub issue #1033: ext2 divergences from Linux that show in the structure
# a guest leaves on its disk. scripts/ext2_postcheck.py stats each row's path
# with debugfs after every writing QEMU lane; when the path is present and
# the regex (what the stat prints once the issue is fixed) matches, the lane
# FAILS, so the fix removes its row here rather than passing silently.
# Columns, tab-separated: issue, path, regex of the fixed stat, reason.
# No row is open: #968 (/grow, a directory past twelve blocks) was fixed and
# its fact is now a presence check, `--indirect-dir /grow` in
# exercises the row machinery with a row of its own.
# Content and size divergences (#1023) are tier B, #1034.
